content:
The hidden cost of over apping your store

In this issue

  • The tax has a name in the report. Forrester raised the cost problem unprompted, before it evaluated a single vendor.
  • What Shopware does without an app, and what it does not. The reason fit beats features is that fit determines how many of those apps you need on day one.
  • Seven conversations, same point of view. We came at the same question from the other direction, our own interviews instead of a scoring model.
  • Do not buy the campaign. Shopware gets held to the same standard as everyone else here.
  • What to do before your next demo. Three things, and none require an analyst subscription.
